title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine 

About Us 

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary 

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

title: Principal of backend
description:
About SchemeServe 

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer 

UK Remote 

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software. 

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal 

This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us. 

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead 

Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority .

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer." 

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded .

The Technical Challenge 

Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:

- .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.

- TypeScript services.

- Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.

- Azure cloud infrastructure.

- Cloudflare platform services.

- API-first architecture.

- Git-based development workflows.

We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do 

You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:

- Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.

- Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.

- Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.

- Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.

- Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.

- Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.

KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex? 
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own: 
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.

What You'll Do 

- Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.

- Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.

- Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.

- Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.

- Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.

- Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

- Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 

- Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.

- Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 

- User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 

- LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer , you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation). 

Responsibilities 

- Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. 

- Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.

- Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models. 

- Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 

- Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. 

- Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. 

- Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.

- Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.

- Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. 

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. 

- Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. 

- Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. 

- Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.

- Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)

- Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects. 

- Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

Role Summary and Impact 

At Code, we design and build digital products and platforms for a range of clients.

We’re looking for a Front-end Engineer with strong browser-side engineering skills who cares about how interfaces work in practice.

You’ll work mainly in TypeScript and React, building responsive, accessible and performant interfaces as part of a multidisciplinary product team. We use application frameworks including React Router and Next.js, but strong foundations in HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter just as much.

This is a senior engineering role, so you’ll do more than implement designs. You’ll help shape how interfaces are built, work closely with designers on interaction and behaviour, contribute to technical decisions, and help other engineers improve their front-end skills.

You’ll also contribute to how we approach front-end engineering across Code, sharing what works and challenging approaches when there’s a better way to do things.

Skills and Experience 

- Build high-quality user interfaces using TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS.

- Work with React Router, Next.js and similar React application frameworks.

- Work closely with designers to turn ideas and designs into usable, responsive interfaces rather than simply reproducing static screens.

- Make accessibility part of the way software is designed and built, not something added at the end.

- Pay close attention to browser performance, loading behaviour and the experience across different devices and connection speeds.

- Help shape component architecture and contribute to reusable design systems and shared patterns.

- Write automated tests at the right level, from component and interaction tests through to browser-based end-to-end testing.

- Review code, talk through approaches and help less experienced engineers develop their skills.

- Work alongside other engineers to understand APIs, application behaviour and how the front end fits into the wider platform.

- Contribute to the front-end engineering community at Code, sharing ideas and helping us improve how we build for the web.

- Highly competent across core front-end skillsets: HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (Vanilla) etc. 

You’ll have good experience building production web applications and strong browser fundamentals.

HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter to us. You should understand how browsers work and be able to build interfaces that are responsive, accessible and robust without relying on a framework to solve everything.

You’ll also need solid TypeScript and React experience, with experience working in applications built with React Router, Next.js or similar approaches.

Accessibility should be familiar territory. You should understand semantic HTML, keyboard interaction, focus management and the practical application of WCAG when building interfaces. You should also have experience testing interfaces with screen readers and understand how common interaction patterns are experienced by people using assistive technology.

Performance matters too. You should be able to investigate and improve things such as loading, rendering, JavaScript execution, images and Core Web Vitals.

You’ll need experience with automated testing. The exact tools are less important than knowing what to test and why, but you may have worked with tools such as Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress.

Working well with designers is important. That means understanding the intent behind a design, talking through interaction and responsive behaviour, spotting problems and contributing to the solution rather than waiting for every detail to be specified.

Experience with design systems, Storybook, design tokens or shared component libraries is useful, particularly if you’ve helped establish patterns rather than simply consumed them.

As a senior engineer, you’ll also be expected to support others. You don’t need to have formally managed people, but you should be able to review work, share what you know and help other engineers develop.

We don’t expect you to match every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong front-end fundamentals, good engineering judgement and a genuine interest in building accessible, well-crafted web interfaces.

The Senior Business Operations Manager is responsible for improving the operational structure, reporting and day-to-day governance that help the business run efficiently and consistently. This is a Senior Manager role: it requires strong, varied operational experience, the ability to lead medium-to-large or more complex cross-functional initiatives with some oversight, and the judgement to make well-reasoned recommendations that balance impact, risk and practicality. The role combines revenue operations, business analysis, process improvement, and quality management as part of a broader business operations remit. It works closely with the Head of Operations, the wider Operations function, the Go-To-Market team, and company-wide stakeholders to turn business priorities into clear processes, reliable reporting and practical operational improvements.

Key responsibilities 

Revenue operations and Salesforce 

- Maintain and improve the revenue operations framework across GTM, including pipeline governance, forecasting cadence, sales process discipline and commercial reporting.

- Your team acts as the business owner for Salesforce and connected revenue systems, ensuring they support current, often high stakes, operating needs, data quality and consistent adoption.

- Define, monitor and interpret key commercial metrics such as bookings, recurring revenue, conversion rates, deal cycle, retention, productivity and forecast accuracy. Drive data consistency in both usage and interpretation across teams as it relates to measuring commercial health.

- Build reporting that helps the business understand performance, diagnose issues and make decisions with confidence.

- Improve data consistency, definitions and reporting processes across teams.

- Use analysis to support business cases, process changes, investment decisions and operational priorities.

Operational excellence and process improvement 

- Design, document and improve business processes so they are scalable, efficient and easy to follow. This could be across a wide range of areas, from Alliances, Marketing, Procurement, and more.

- Define and lead medium-to-large cross-functional operational projects from diagnosis through to implementation and adoption, with appropriate oversight from senior leaders.

- Proactively identify bottlenecks, duplication, control gaps and opportunities for improvement within Operations and across related functions, then recommend practical solutions that reduce cost, risk or manual effort. Provide support to implement these recommendations.

- Establish operating rhythms, review cadences and governance forums that create accountability and visibility across the business.

- Support change management by communicating the context, purpose and value of work clearly, engaging stakeholders and embedding new ways of working.

ISO9001 and quality management 

- Own the ongoing maintenance of ISO9001 accreditation and ensure the quality management system remains effective, current and audit-ready.

- Coordinate internal audits, external assessments, corrective actions and continuous improvement activity.

- Maintain quality documentation, process controls, evidence records and governance materials.

- Work with process owners to ensure quality standards are embedded into day-to-day business operations.

- Build capability within the team through regular feedback, mentorship, development planning and knowledge sharing, with limited people growth decisions made with supervisory approval.

- Create a motivating, cohesive and engaging team environment by providing context, making clear decisions and ensuring feedback and priorities are transparent.

- Promote cross-functional collaboration by documenting knowledge, sharing learnings and building trusted relationships with peers and stakeholders.

- Strong, varied experience in business operations, revenue operations, sales operations, commercial operations or a similar role, typically including 3-5 years of management experience.

- Strong Salesforce ownership or administration experience, with the ability to translate business needs into practical system and process requirements.

- Confident with PowerBI reporting and data visualisation capability, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Commercial awareness and confidence working with revenue, pipeline, forecasting and performance data.

- Experience defining and leading medium-to-large cross-functional projects or initiatives, managing senior stakeholders independently and navigating ambiguity with sound judgement.

- Understanding of ISO9001, quality management systems, audit preparation and continuous improvement principles.

- People management experience, including coaching, prioritisation, performance management and team development.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data or process issues clearly to different audiences.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. - Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. - Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product .

- Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems.

- Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem.

- Experience implementing IAM federation.

- Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.

- Experience with L3 support/incident management.

- Experience working in a fully remote organization.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.

Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.

Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.

The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.

Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.

With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users.

Due to significant growth and to address the evolving needs of our QA team, we are seeking a Quality Engineer .

You will join a structured QA community of about half a dozen engineers based across France and the United States, allowing you to share best practices and grow technically with your international peers. On a daily basis, you will be fully integrated into an Agile Product squad, working hand-in-hand with developers and product managers. You will report directly to the Manager of the Quality Engineering team.

Key Responsibilities 

- 
Test Case Design & Execution: Design comprehensive and efficient test cases based on product requirements and user stories. Execute tests (both manual and automated) to ensure product quality and functionality meet our high defined standards.

- 
Test Automation: Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts to ensure long-term efficiency and scalability in our testing processes.

- 
Collaboration & Leadership: Act as a leadership driving force within your squad. You will actively lead the collaboration between the Product Manager (PM) and Developers to define, clarify, and prioritize quality and testability requirements from the very start.

- 
Bug Tracking & Analysis : Identify, document, and track defects in Jira, and work with the engineering team to prioritize and resolve them.

- 
CI/CD Integration : Integrate automated tests into our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to streamline the release process.

- 
Quality Culture : Act as an internal advocate for QA best practices, helping the whole team maintain high standards.

- 
Participation in Agile Ceremonies: Actively contribute to all agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring a strong quality mindset throughout the development cycle.

Required Qualifications 

- 
Education & Experience: Engineering degree or Master’s degree with 7 years of experience in a technical QA or development field.

- 
Testing Frameworks & Tools: Strong hands-on experience with tools like Playwright, PactumJS, Jest, Postman, or Cucumber . Familiarity with other frameworks like Cypress or RestAssured is also highly valued.

- 
Methodology & Test Management: Solid knowledge of BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) and familiarity with test management tools like Xray (or similar).

- 
CI/CD & Innovation: Good knowledge of CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI (or similar tools). A strong interest and familiarity with leveraging AI tools to optimize testing efficiency is a plus.

- 
Nice to Have: Prior experience with Salesforce testing is a significant advantage.

- 
Soft Skills: A true team player with strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a genuine interest in evolving technologies.

- 
Languages: Fully fluent in both English and French (essential for daily collaboration with both your local squad and US-based QA peers).

Where You'll Be 

- Based in Paris (75002), France.

- Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.

- Full time permanent contract position.

At Odaseva , we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative .

Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork .

Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is also the team with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2). 

The long term vision is simple: the agent becomes the action layer between patients and everything the front desk used to do by hand. The integrations are the road to get there. You would be building that road.

- The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that can handle the rules of each medical centre and where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

- The hard integrations that nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

- How the team works. Engineering team is growing fast and will organise in squads. You will define how this one works: reviews, documentation, technical decisions. You will be one of the most experienced engineers in the company and we will expect you to act like it.

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors.
We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

- We use AI seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

- For this role we are looking a the senior who frames the work first, sets guardrails and reviews carefully.

- We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. But the judgment about what not to touch is yours.

- We talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the support team that hears when something breaks.

- Ship your first fix on a live integration.

- Write down how our booking layer should evolve.

- Adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

title: Strategic Account Management Coordinator
description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That’s the future we’re building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don’t just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly : our network, our partners, and ourselves.

Our mission is as simple as it is ambitious: Accelerate Sustainable Mobility by investing in, installing, and operating EV charging stations through an innovative business model. We help businesses find the right charging solutions for their customers and make EV charging more accessible, reliable, and integrated into everyday life.

We are Partner Obsessed 🤝 — creating tailor-made solutions that better serve our partners and their customers. We’re driven by the challenge of making EV charging simpler and more readily available 💡. And we’re committed to growing relentlessly 📈 — our network, our partners’ businesses, and the professional development of our team.
If you’re here, you’re probably not looking for “just a job.” Neither are we. 😎 We’re driven by impact and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you’ll feel at home here. We’re looking for people who see challenges as opportunities, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you’ll get freedom , ownership , and responsibility . The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that’s always pushing the edge of what’s possible.

🚀 About this Role

As our Strategic Account Management Coordinator , you’ll hold a key position within the Sales team, directly responsible for the Major Accounts scope — partners who manage multiple sites across their portfolio. You’ll operate at the centre of the electric mobility ecosystem, where technology, infrastructure, and a dynamic retail environment come together.
Your mission is to grow and protect Powerdot’s most valuable partner relationships by building long-term trust, monitoring account and station performance, and turning insights into actions that improve partner satisfaction and business results. You’ll act as the bridge between our major accounts and every internal team, ensuring that partner needs are understood, prioritised, and delivered — while continuously raising the quality of the partner experience.

How You’ll Shape Our Story: 
Your day-to-day will include:

- Managing and developing long-term relationships with Powerdot’s major accounts and strategic partners, building trust and becoming their go-to contact.

- Monitoring account performance — tracking key metrics to identify opportunities to improve partner satisfaction, station performance, and business growth.

- Preparing and leading quarterly business reviews — analysing performance, extracting key insights, and building clear action plans to share with partners.

- Acting as the main point of contact for partners — understanding their needs and coordinating the appropriate internal teams to address them.

- Working cross-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and other Powerdot teams to ensure smooth account management and delivery.

- Developing and implementing partner-specific initiatives — including promotional campaigns, special operations, and other commercial opportunities.

- Monitoring operational station performance — proactively identifying issues, risks, and opportunities across the charging stations in your accounts’ portfolios.

- Translating partner feedback into action — converting partner needs and business priorities into actionable recommendations for internal teams.

- Contributing to process improvement — helping continuously improve Powerdot’s strategic account management processes and overall partner experience.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼: 

- 1–2 years of experience in strategy or consulting, ideally combined with experience in account management, business development, or a client-facing role.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you can structure complex topics and turn insights into actionable recommendations.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — you can interact confidently with senior clients and coordinate across multiple internal teams.

- Strong business acumen — you understand what drives partner value and commercial success.

- A customer-oriented mindset — you put the partner at the centre of your decisions and act on their behalf.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities — you thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

- Interest in electric mobility, technology, and infrastructure — you’re curious about the evolving retail ecosystem and the future of mobility.

- An ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes and follow through from insight to action.

The Kind of Energy We’re Looking For: 

- We’re not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We’re into people who make things happen.

- You lead and listen. You build trust with senior partners while staying attuned to what internal teams need to deliver.

- You own your stuff. You don’t stop at identifying an opportunity: you turn it into an action plan and see it through.

- You’re commercially minded. You understand that great account management drives both partner satisfaction and sustainable business growth.

- You bring structure to complexity. You can manage multiple accounts, stakeholders, and priorities without losing sight of the outcome.

- You’ve got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn’t just cool, it’s core. You care about building partnerships that make electric mobility more accessible.

- You balance rigour with relationships. You’re disciplined about analysis and follow-through, but you never lose the human touch with partners.

- You grow on purpose. You’re eager to learn, deepen your commercial expertise, and help Powerdot strengthen its most strategic relationships.

How you'll be Powered up? 

- 🏥 Private health insurance coverage

- 💪🏼 Gym membership to support your wellbeing

- ⏰ Flexible working hours so you can manage your time effectively

- 🌍 Annual offsite to celebrate achievements and connect with colleagues

- 🤝🏼 Regular team-building activities with your local team

- 📚 English training to support collaboration across all markets and teams

- 🍩 Free office snacks, unlimited coffee, and meal allowance for every worked day

- ⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You 
The best solutions come from different voices. We’re committed to building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity are part of everyday life. At Powerdot, everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and create positive change.
Whether you’re strengthening a partner relationship, leading a quarterly review, or turning feedback into action, your contribution matters. At Powerdot, you’ll have the space to learn, take ownership, and help build partnerships that power the future of mobility. Your voice helps power the future — literally.

title: Ingénieur Qualité Fournisseur
Senior Product Manager - F/H
description:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement : 

- Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier.

- Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus.

- Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre.

- Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment.

- Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes.

- Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi.

- Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

- Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? 

- Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien.

- Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

- Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.) 

- Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage.

Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.

Pré-requis du poste 

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons 

- Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul.

- Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes.

- Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider.

- Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit.

- Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.

- Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? 

- Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

- Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

- Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

- Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog .

title: MAÎTRE DE CONFÉRENCES dans le domaine du Génie Civil et des milieux poreux H/F - CDI - IMT Mines Alès
description:
Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr . 

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil". 

En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique. 

Activités d'enseignement 

- Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Énergie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ; 

- Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du Bâtiment dans sa globalité, calculs de structures mais aussi conception générale du bâtiment ou encore Building Information Modeling (BIM) ; 

- Piloter et encadrer un projet de conception tous corps d’état dans la filière Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO) ; 

- Proposer des sujets de missions recherche et développement et en assurer le suivi pour un équivalent de 2 à 3 missions par an ; 

- Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ; 

- Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ; 

- Assurer le suivi du parcours ingénieur-architecte en lien avec l’école d’architecture de Montpellier, l’Université de Liège et l’École Polytechnique de Mons. 

- Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an. 

Activités de recherche 

- Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ; 

- Renforcer l’interconnexion entre une modélisation numérique thermo-hygro-chémomécanique (THCM) et les expériences de laboratoire ; 

- Développer notamment la partie caractérisation des milieux poreux à travers la détermination de la fraction connectée de la porosité, la fraction segmentée de la porosité, la perméabilité, la diffusivité apparente, le degré de saturation…. ; 

- Mener une recherche sur la compréhension du transport de fluides, de la réactivité chimique et de la mécanique des milieux poreux de divers matériaux en particulier les matériaux de construction (matériaux à matrice cimentaire, matériaux pour l’enveloppe, béton de terre crue…) ; 

- Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil. 

Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique 

- Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ; 

- Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ; 

- Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production. 

- Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques. 

Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ici : 

https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/JNC6keL3fq6E8Fn 

Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des milieux poreux, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Vous devrez disposer d’une expérience solide en recherche, démontrer votre capacité à développer des collaborations scientifiques, à publier vos travaux et à valoriser les résultats de recherche auprès de partenaires académiques et industriels. La maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique est requise ; une expérience internationale et une capacité à vous intégrer aux projets du LMGC et du C2MA constitueront des atouts. 

Les critères d'évaluation sont les suivants : 

Diplôme requis : diplôme d’ingénieur ou master en génie civil ou en bâtiment durable, ainsi qu’un doctorat en génie civil ou en sciences des matériaux. 

Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité d’enseignement : 

- Niveau des enseignements dispensés

L’exercice de responsabilités, les activités d’organisation et la participation à des instances de concertation et de décision entrent également en compte dans les critères examinés. 

Modalités de candidature 

Le dossier de candidature est à télécharger sur ce lien : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/DT9ZZPFPNpHm5HD 

Il est à compléter en français uniquement si vous remplissez les conditions indiquées ci-dessus. 

Il est accompagné, notamment, d’un curriculum vitae, d’une lettre de motivation, d’éventuelles lettres de recommandation ainsi que d’une copie de votre carte d’identité, de vos diplômes et de toute attestation de formation ou de stage. 

Planning du recrutement

Personnes à contacter

Jean-Claude SOUCHE, Responsable du département GCBD, Gwenn LE SAOUT, Référent auprès de l’unité mixte LMGC, Anne BERGERET , Professeur, directrice du C2MA,

title: Une Experte ou un Expert Métier DataSpaceLab – Santé & industrie du futur - DVE – CDD 22 mois
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. 

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. 

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous 

En tant qu ’ Expert.e métier DataSpaceLab, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en développement, recherche et innovation rattaché à la Direction du Développement et des relations avec les Entreprises (DVE). Vous y conjuguez développement de partenariats, innovation et impact sociétal au service des grands enjeux industriels et de santé. 

Le Data Space Lab est la brique opérationnelle du Hub France de Gaia-X, l’initiative européenne de référence pour les espaces de données et la souveraineté numérique, porté par l’Institut Mines-Télécom. 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, il s’adosse aux centres de recherche de l’École et à leurs domaines d’excellence : ingénierie de la santé (CIS), industrie du futur et microélectronique, matériaux et procédés, énergie et environnement. 

L’enjeu : faire émerger des espaces de données métiers au service de ces filières, au premier rang desquelles la santé et l’industrie du futur, en lien avec l’écosystème industriel et territorial. 

Ce recrutement vise à doter Mines Saint-Étienne d’un.e expert.e métier capable de structurer, sur le territoire et en lien avec l’écosystème national Gaia-X, des cas d’usage et des démonstrateurs d’espaces de données, en valorisant les domaines d’excellence de l’École, au premier rang desquels la santé et l’industrie du futur. 

- Vous assurez le développement et l’animation du Data Space Lab à Saint-Étienne, en faisant comprendre Gaia-X et les espaces de données aux entreprises (PME et ETI), aux collectivités et aux acteurs du territoire. 

- Vous participez au montage de projets régionaux, nationaux et européens (Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, Bpifrance « espaces de données ») avec les équipes de l’IMT et des partenaires industriels et territoriaux. 

- Vous contribuez à la spécification des cas d’usage et à l’émergence de démonstrateurs concrets d’espaces de données métiers, dans les domaines d’excellence de Mines Saint-Étienne — santé et bien-être (CIS), industrie du futur, énergie et environnement, transport et logistique, ainsi qu’à la structuration et à l’animation d’un écosystème de partenaires (événements, communautés scientifiques de l’IMT, Caisse des Dépôts). 

- Vous rendez compte au Directeur du développement et travaillez en lien fonctionnel étroit avec les deux autres chargés de développement filière (IMT Atlantique et DG IMT) et le coordinateur national du Data Space Lab. 

- Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer recherche, monde industriel et acteurs territoriaux sera essentielle pour réussir. 

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons 

Vous êtes titulaire d’un : 

· Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent 

Et idéalement : 

· Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’école de commerce (Bac+5) 

· Avec une expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans le montage de projets collaboratifs ou le développement de partenariats 

· Junior accepté : non (profil expérimenté privilégié) 

• Une expérience significative en montage de projets collaboratifs nationaux et/ou européens 

• Une expérience confirmée en tant que chargé d’affaires ou en développement commercial 

• Une expertise avérée en gestion de projet et coordination d’écosystèmes d’acteurs 

• Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1) et une grande aisance rédactionnelle 

Vos atouts supplémentaires : 

• Connaissance de l’écosystème académique, des pôles de compétitivité et de l’industrie

title: Chargée ou chargé d'affaires réglementaires - CDD 12 Mois
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. 

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. 

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. 

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. 

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. 

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) ! 

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé. 

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions. 

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science. 

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous 

Au sein du Centre Ingénierie et Santé et du MedTechLab, vous contribuez au déploiement d’une stratégie technico-réglementaire permettant de sécuriser le développement, l’expérimentation, l’évaluation et, le cas échéant, la mise sur le marché de produits et services innovants en santé, notamment de dispositifs médicaux et de solutions de santé numérique.

Le MedTechLab®, cofondé par Mines Saint-Étienne, AÉSIO Santé et AÉSIO Mutuelle, est un espace d’open innovation dédié à la co-création, la modélisation, le test et l’expérimentation d’innovations pour la santé et l’autonomie. Lauréat de l’appel à projets Tiers Lieux d’Expérimentation de France 2030, il accompagne industriels, start-up et acteurs sanitaires et médico-sociaux dans des études d’usage, études cliniques, analyses médico-économiques, études de marché et démarches allant jusqu’au développement de produits minimum viables.

Vous intervenez en appui des équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, en lien avec les partenaires académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Vous accompagnez les projets sur leurs différentes étapes : R&D, stratégie réglementaire, recherche clinique, gestion des risques, constitution et maintenance de la documentation technique, marquage CE et suivi post-marquage.

Objectif du poste : garantir la prise en compte des exigences réglementaires et qualité applicables aux projets du MedTechLab et développer une culture partagée des affaires réglementaires au sein de l’écosystème.

Vos missions principales : 

• Contrôler la conformité des activités et des processus au regard des référentiels applicables et contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de la documentation des systèmes et outils qualité.

• Dans le cadre du projet PREMYOM, accompagner le comité d’éthique interne du consortium en lien avec les DPO des différents partenaires.

• Identifier les normes et réglementations applicables aux projets de recherche et d’innovation du MedTechLab, assurer une veille réglementaire et normative et coordonner cette veille avec les partenaires.

• Accompagner la mise en œuvre des normes ISO 14155, ISO 13485 et ISO 14971, notamment pour les études cliniques, les systèmes de management de la qualité et l’analyse des risques.

• Accompagner les équipes dans la conformité des recherches cliniques et apporter un appui méthodologique et technique.

• Contribuer aux stratégies de marquage CE : supervision et rédaction des dossiers techniques, déclarations de mise sur le marché, maintien de la documentation de conformité et suivi post-marquage.

• Piloter l’évaluation réglementaire des changements, gérer la liste des normes appliquées aux projets et traiter les questions réglementaires et techniques des autorités de santé à la suite des dépôts de dossiers.

• Dans le cadre du RGPD, veiller, en lien avec les DPO de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’AÉSIO Santé, à la conformité des projets et au respect des procédures.

• Préparer et animer les réunions qualité / affaires réglementaires, contribuer aux comités de pilotage, suivre les indicateurs, élaborer des tableaux de bord et communiquer sur la démarche d’amélioration continue.

• Participer aux réseaux professionnels et entretenir les relations utiles avec les autorités et organismes compétents (ANSM, ANS, CNIL, CPP, CNAM, etc.).

• Définir les stratégies réglementaires des produits (classification, voie de mise sur le marché, marchés cibles : UE, France, puis international)

• Assurer la veille sur les évolutions normatives et réglementaires (MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746, AI Act, RGPD, cybersécurité, données de santé) et en mesurer l'impact

• Anticiper les exigences liées aux innovations (logiciels dispositifs médicaux, IA, objets connectés, etc.)

• Gérer les échanges avec les organismes notifiés

• Sensibiliser et former les équipes internes aux enjeux réglementaires

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires, de la qualité ou du droit de la santé :

• Licence professionnelle, Master 1 ou Master 2 en affaires réglementaires, droit de la santé, qualité appliquée aux produits de santé ou formation équivalente sont privilégié. Également une première expérience en affaires réglementaires dans le secteur de la santé (dispositifs médicaux, e-santé ou médicament). Profils juniors motivés à étudier selon le contexte.

Connaissances recherchées : 

• Réglementation des dispositifs médicaux et référentiels associés, notamment règlement (UE) 2017/745 (MDR), ISO 13485, ISO 14155 et ISO 14971.

• Réglementation des recherches cliniques, bonnes pratiques cliniques, RGPD, procédures de recherche clinique, cycle de développement d’un projet innovant en santé, vocabulaire médical et scientifique.

Compétences attendues : 

• Capacité à identifier et interpréter les exigences réglementaires et normatives applicables à un projet, et à les traduire en actions opérationnelles.

• Maîtrise des méthodes d’analyse des risques, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion documentaire ; capacité à contribuer à des dossiers techniques et de marquage CE.

• Capacité à conduire des projets transversaux, à argumenter des solutions en assurance qualité / affaires réglementaires et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs académiques, cliniques, industriels et institutionnels.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et capacité à élaborer des outils de suivi, indicateurs et tableaux de bord.

• Anglais scientifique écrit ; capacité à échanger en anglais dans un contexte professionnel appréciée.

Qualités personnelles :

• Autonomie, rigueur, organisation, sens des priorités, polyvalence et capacité d’adaptation ; respect du secret professionnel, de l’éthique et de la réglementation en vigueur.

• Curiosité pour l'innovation et capacité à trouver des solutions conformes

• Aisance relationnelle, sens du travail en équipe et capacité à communiquer avec des partenaires variés. Des déplacements ponctuels en France sont à prévoir selon les projets.

Relations professionnelles : médecins investigateurs, TEC, chefs de projets de recherche clinique, biostatisticiens, data-managers, équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, partenaires AÉSIO, structures de recherche clinique et technologique, start-up et industriels, ainsi que les instances administratives et réglementaires compétentes.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time. 

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue. 

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for. 

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach. 

Within 1 month, you will: 

- 
Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture 

- 
Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer 

- 
Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily 

- 
Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end 

Within 3 months, you will: 

- 
Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end 

- 
Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production 

- 
Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up 

Within 6 months, you will: 

- 
Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts 

- 
Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention 

- 
Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting 

Within 12 months, you will: 

- 
Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks 

- 
Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope 

- 
Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about 

The Skill Set: 

- 
5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice 

- 
Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security 

- 
Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too 

- 
Infrastructure as code: Terraform, GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines 

- 
Scripting and automation: Python or Go, plus shell. Comfortable reading and writing code, and opening pull requests on repositories owned by other teams 

- 
Log analysis and investigation: cloud audit logs, query languages, correlation across identity, network and application sources 

- 
Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR). 

- 
Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L 

What we offer: 

- 
Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈 

- 
Benefits/Perks : Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 

- 
Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠 

- 
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion : We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝 

- 
Corporate Social Responsibility : Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍 

- 
Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆 

Interview Process: 

- Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager 

- Discovery Meeting with our Head of Security 

- Live exercise with our Head of Security and our Head of Devops: investigation of an incident scenario, or review of an insecure infrastructure configuration 

- Clarification Meeting with the Security Engineer and a DevOps engineer 

- Culture Fit Meeting with our VP of Engineering 

- Offer! 

Who We Are 

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place. 

360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role 

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities 

- Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

- Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

- Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

- Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

- Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

- Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements 

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you: 

- 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

- Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

- Clear, polished written English

- You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

- Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

- Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

- At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves 

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

- German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

- Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

- Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

- Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams 

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @ cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.
