title: Senior Client Partner - Microsoft Advertising
description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 

At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Driving Revenue Growth and Strategic Client Expansion 

As a Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in driving commercial growth and expanding Aleph's footprint in Switzerland, directly contributing to revenue generation, portfolio expansion, and long-term strategic client partnerships.

This is a revenue-driven, commercially focused role. You will own a book of business, identify new growth opportunities, and position Aleph as a strategic partner within the Swiss digital advertising ecosystem.

What You Will Do 

Revenue Growth and Portfolio Expansion 

- Sell Microsoft Advertising solutions to both new and existing advertisers.

- Proactively generate new leads, build a robust sales pipeline, and maintain accurate CRM records of all sales activities.

- Consistently achieve sales targets while delivering a high-quality customer sales experience.

- Accurately forecast weekly, monthly, and annual revenue performance.

Strategic Client Leadership 

- Build and maintain a strong network of contacts across key verticals through industry events, outreach, and market engagement.

- Engage regularly with new and existing clients to understand campaign objectives, KPIs, and future marketing plans.

- Recommend tailored solutions from the product portfolio to help clients achieve their business and marketing goals.

- Lead onboarding processes for new clients, including guiding them through legal and compliance requirements.

Market and Cross-Functional Impact 

- Stay up to date with market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.

- Introduce Aleph to new prospects and expand presence across target industries.

- Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (Account Managers) to ensure smooth campaign launches and execution.

- Provide timely, actionable feedback to clients to optimize performance and strengthen relationships.

What We Are Looking For 

- 3+ years of digital advertising experience, in business development, account management, key account management, or ad sales.

- Strong understanding of the Swiss advertising ecosystem, with an established network across key industry players and stakeholders, particularly within media agencies, as well as advertisers and publishers.

- Strong commercial skills, with direct responsibility for revenue.

- Direct experience in paid search advertising (SEM), performance advertising, and e-commerce.

- The ability to work independently and set your own workflows to achieve sales targets, including in a fully remote setup.

- Right to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).

- Fluency in French and English. French is a plus.

How Success Looks 

As a Senior Client Partner at Aleph, success means driving real business results for clients while making a measurable impact on the team and the company. You will know you are thriving when:

- Clients trust you as a strategic partner, seeing tangible growth and measurable improvements in their campaigns and overall performance.

- You consistently hit or exceed your individual revenue and performance targets while contributing to the collective goals of the team.

- You identify opportunities for expansion, optimizing strategies and processes to deliver smarter, more efficient campaigns.

- You actively bring in new clients and business opportunities, closing deals that fuel both client growth and Aleph's market expansion.

- You actively collaborate, share knowledge, and bring innovative ideas that improve outcomes for clients and the team alike.

What You Get at Aleph 

- Impact: You will own a book of business and shape how Swiss advertisers use Microsoft Advertising, with results you can measure in revenue and client growth.

- Growth: Move across teams, take on new responsibilities, and expand your expertise within a network that represents 55+ leading digital platforms.

- Team culture: Join a collaborative, innovative team that encourages initiative, creativity, and ownership, and that welcomes people from every background.

- Market context: Switzerland is a premium advertising market, worth CHF 4.1 billion in net advertising revenue in 2025, with online advertising as its largest segment.

- Flexibility and wellbeing: Work fully remotely from Switzerland, with global exposure and a benefits package designed to support your personal development and quality of life.

Why Join Us? 

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities. 

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

- Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

- Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

- Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

- Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements 

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

- Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

- Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

- Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

- Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus 

- Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

- Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

- Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential 

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

- Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

- Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

- Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

Location
This role is remote-first. [please fill with specific location / timezone requirements].

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - NA
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

About the role: 

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

- Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

- Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

- Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

- Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

- Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role 

Must Haves: 

- Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

- Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

- Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

- Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

- Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

- Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves: 

- Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

- Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

- Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

- Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

This role is an existing vacancy

- Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Zurich, Switzerland
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview 

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward. 

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features

- Shape the future of our Android team

- Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features

- Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering

- Review pull requests, and support other teammates

- Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges 

- Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience

- Familiarity with Android components

- Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app

- Product design intuition and user empathy

- Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX

- Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests

- Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec

- Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests

- Excellent communication skills

- User oriented problem solving approach

- Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus: 

- Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android

- Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use: 

- Kotlin

- Kotlin Coroutines

- Kotlin Flow

- Jetpack Navigation

- Dagger 2

- Room

- Custom Views, Canvas & Paint

- Jetpack Compose

- JUnit

What We offer :

- A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.

- An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.

- A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.

- An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.

- Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.

- Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

- Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.

- Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

The Switzerland Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

title: Praktikant - Editorial Content (all genders)
description:
Starte deine ganz persönliche Reise – mit HolidayCheck! Bei HolidayCheck dreht sich alles darum, gemeinsam Urlaub besser zu machen. Dabei ermöglichen wir nicht nur unseren UrlauberInnen die schönste Zeit im Jahr, sondern kreieren auch für unsere HolidayCheckerInnen eine einmalige Arbeitsatmosphäre in unseren modernen Büros in München oder in Bottighofen (Schweiz).

Unsere Unternehmenswerte leben wir täglich: als #TeamHolidayCheck schaffen wir Vertrauen, übernehmen Verantwortung und lieben, was wir tun – für den perfekten Urlaub!

Du liebst Reisen, hast ein Gespür für Trends und möchtest lernen, wie aus einer guten Idee Content wird, der Millionen UrlauberInnen erreicht und inspiriert? In unserem Editorial Content Team arbeitest Du an aktuellen Reisethemen, entwickelst Inhalte für SEO und Google Discover und begleitest sie von der Recherche und Themenfindung bis zur Veröffentlichung und Auswertung. Dabei lernst Du, wie Storytelling, Daten und KI zusammenspielen, und kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, ausprobieren und direkt sehen, welchen Impact dein Content hat. 

Deine Aufgaben - Entdeckung relevanter Reisetrends über Newsportale, Blogs und Social Media
- Entwicklung inspirierender Inhalte mit Fokus auf Storytelling und Nutzerinteresse
- Verfassen zielgruppengerechter Texte für SEO und Google Discover unter Berücksichtigung aktueller Trends und saisonaler Themen
- Du testest neue Ansätze rund um GEO und KI-Suche und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungen für unsere redaktionellen Inhalte ab
- Recherche von Keywords, Themenfindung und nutzerorientierte Aufbereitung von Inhalten
- Pflege, Aktualisierung und Optimierung bestehender Inhalte im CMS
- Aktive Mitgestaltung der Content- und Discoverstrategie mit Fokus auf Sichtbarkeit, Conversion und Interaktivität
- Analyse von KPIs zur Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen und kontinuierlichen Optimierung neuer sowie bestehender Inhalte
- Unterstützung bei der Pflege von Media-Assets sowie beim Feedbackprozess von Reisevideos
- gezielter Einsatz von KI-Tools und automatisierten Workflows

Das bringst du mit - Interesse an einem Praktikum im Bereich Editorial Content
- Begeisterung für Reisen und starke Affinität zu digitalen Inhalten, SEO und Social Media
- Freude an kreativem Storytelling und daran, Inhalte wie Texte, Bilder oder Videos für unsere UrlauberInnen zu gestalten
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ein sorgfältiger und klarer Schreibstil
- Hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, Lösungsorientierung und eine praxisnahe, selbstständige Arbeitsweise
- Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office sowie ein strukturierter und präziser Umgang mit Aufgaben und Tools

Entwicklung & Kultur - Vom Newbie zum Champion: Strukturiertes Onboarding für einen perfekten Start  
- Umfangreiche Trainingsangebote & regelmäßiges Feedback 
- Vielfältige Unternehmenskultur mit über 30 Nationalitäten  
- Perspektive auf eine Festanstellung nach dem Studium

title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
description:
Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.

Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.

Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.

Why us? - Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
- No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
- We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
- Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
- Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
- Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.

Process - Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
- Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
- Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
- Meet the team in our Zurich office.
- A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

title: Head of Product Cost Optimization (m/w/d)
description:
About The Company 

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

Über die Position 

Werde Teil von GROPYUS und übernimm die Führung beim Aufbau einer erstklassigen Cost-Optimization-Funktion für unsere Gebäudesysteme. An der Schnittstelle von Produktentwicklung, Engineering, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung gestaltest du die Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer Produkte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg. 

Als Head of Cost Optimization / Building Systems definierst du Strategie, Methoden und Governance für die Kostenoptimierung unseres Produktportfolios. Du schaffst ein datenbasiertes Verständnis der Kostentreiber, identifizierst Potenziale zur Wertsteigerung und stellst sicher, dass Kostenaspekte von der ersten Konzeptphase bis zur industrialisierten Umsetzung in sämtliche Produkt- und Systementscheidungen integriert werden. 

Diese strategische Führungsrolle richtet sich an eine Persönlichkeit, die fundierte Expertise im Kostenmanagement mit ausgeprägtem technischem, industriellem und kaufmännischem Verständnis verbindet. Du baust die Cost-Optimization-Funktion auf und weiter aus, hinterfragst bestehende Annahmen und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung der Gebäudesysteme von GROPYUS. 

Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst: 

- Definition und Führung der Cost-Optimization-Strategie für den Bereich Building Systems, um Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Wertschöpfung über das gesamte Produktportfolio hinweg sicherzustellen 

- Gemeinsame Entwicklung und Implementierung von Design-to-Cost-, Should-Costing-, Value-Engineering- und Target-Costing-Methoden in den Bereichen Produktentwicklung, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung 

- Systematische Identifikation, Bewertung und Priorisierung von Kostenoptimierungspotenzialen für Gebäudesysteme, Komponenten, Materialien und Schnittstellen 

- Aufbau transparenter Kostenmodelle und Feedbackschleifen, um kontinuierliches Lernen aus geplanten und tatsächlich realisierten Kosten zu ermöglichen 

- Führung und Weiterentwicklung des Cost-Optimization-Teams sowie Etablierung klarer Standards, Prozesse und Kompetenzen zur Unterstützung des Unternehmenswachstums 

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften aus Product, Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Construction und R&D, um Kostenbewusstsein in strategischen und operativen Entscheidungen zu verankern 

Über dich 

Minimale Voraussetzungen 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Cost Engineering, Produktkalkulation, Value Engineering, Kostenoptimierung oder einer vergleichbaren kaufmännischen Führungsfunktion, idealerweise in der Bau- oder Bauzulieferindustrie 

- Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Kostenreduktionsprogramme mit messbarem wirtschaftlichem Mehrwert 

- Fundiertes Verständnis komplexer Produkt- und Systemkostenstrukturen einschließlich Materialien, Fertigungsprozessen, Lieferketten sowie Montage- und Installationskosten 

- Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Führung von Teams, in der Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Stakeholdern sowie im Management organisatorischer Veränderungen 

- Ausgeprägte datengetriebene Arbeitsweise sowie ein solides Verständnis für digitale Werkzeuge, Datenanalysen und Performance-Management-Systeme 

- Regelmäßige Reisebereitschaft zwischen unseren Standorten 

- Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse 

Bevorzugte Voraussetzungen 

- Erfahrung im industrialisierten Bauen, modularen Gebäudesystemen, der Vorfertigung oder in hochautomatisierten Fertigungsumgebungen 

- Kenntnisse im Holzbau, von Gebäudesystemen (TGA, Fassaden- und Tragwerkssysteme), im deutschsprachigen Baumarktumfeld sowie im Umgang mit digitalen Kalkulations- und Costing-Tools 

- Lean Six Sigma Zertifizierung und/oder nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Continuous-Improvement-Methoden in komplexen operativen Umgebungen 

- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse 

Was wir bieten 

- Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen. 

- Flexible Arbeitsweise : Wir legen großen Wert auf regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Büro, und bieten auch die Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie die Option, bis zu 40 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

- Attraktive Zusatzleistungen : Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.

- Virtuelles Aktienprogramm : Profitiere von GROPYUS Erfolg durch unser Virtuelles Aktienprogramm.

- Eigenverantwortung : Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.

- Die Chance, Teil von etwas Großem zu sein : Unsere Mission ist es, eine ganze Branche neu zu denken. Hilf uns dabei, das Bauwesen neu zu erfinden und nachhaltiges, erschwingliches Wohnen zu fördern.

- Ein vielfältiges und bereicherndes Arbeitsumfeld : Werde ein geschätztes Mitglied eines wunderbar vielfältigen Teams von Menschen aus über 50 Ländern. Bei GROPYUS legen wir großen Wert auf Inklusion und sorgen dafür, dass sich jeder – unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund – als Teil der Gemeinschaft fühlt. So werden unsere Unterschiede zu Stärken, die uns als Team weiterbringen. 

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you. 
For more information, visit our website .

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. 

GET TO KNOW US 

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. 

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

Our Sales team is the driving force behind Wellhub's new customer acquisition and growth across Germany. As a Enterprise Account Executive , you will be key in expanding Wellhub's Germany client book focusing on Mid-market and Enterprise prospects. You will build strategic partnerships with key decision-makers, crafting personalized solutions that address their unique challenges. 

This role offers a significant opportunity for both professional and financial growth, with a competitive compensation package that directly rewards your results. We seek a collaborator who is passionate about achieving excellence, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and shares our commitment to fostering a positive and supportive team culture. If you possess an entrepreneurial spirit, a desire to lead by example, and a passion for building meaningful relationships with clients, we encourage you to apply. This is a hybrid role with the expectation to be in the office 1X / week. 

YOUR IMPACT 

- New Business Development : Engage with new strategic accounts to uncover new revenue opportunities and develop customised solutions that meet the needs of Enterprise prospects (+501 FTEs in Germany). 

- Senior Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, Reward Directors, and Wellbeing leaders. Ensure that Wellhub is not only aligned with business goals but also drives tangible, measurable results. 

- Pipeline Generation : Work closely with our Sales Development team to strategise on opening new opportunities as well complete personal pipeline generation to ensure steady and consistent pipeline. 

- Account Strategy Developmen t: Develop and implement strategic account plans that focus on delivering impactful business outcomes—whether improving talent attraction, enhancing spend efficiency, or reducing Private Medical costs. 

- Industry Engagement: Represent Wellhub at key industry events, forums, and conferences, showcasing our vision and capabilities in shaping the future of Employee Wellbeing. 

- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. 

WHO YOU ARE 

- Proven Success in SaaS Sales: Experience in enterprise sales new logo acquisition(501+ FTEs in Germany ) with a strong track record of driving revenue growth and working on ticket sizes of £100K - £500K+. 

- Expertise in Strategic Account Management: Experience in managing complex sales cycles (6 months+), developing new business opportunities, and fostering long-term relationships within a target-driven environment. 

- Strong Stakeholder Engagement: Comfortably engage with C-suite executives, key decision-makers, and senior stakeholders across HR, finance, and business functions to align solutions with customer needs. 

- Complex Sales Expertise: Skilled at managing multi-phase sales cycles, navigating intricate procurement and compliance processes, and presenting compelling value propositions to senior leadership. 

- Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and present them in an approachable and engaging way. Comfort and interest in using data effectively in the Sales process 

- Data & Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and present in a compelling way to prospects. Comfort in using commercial insight to recommend and simplify investment options to a prospect. 

- Passion for Learning: A deep enthusiasm for the Sales profession and how to constantly improve individually and collectively 

- A I-savvy: We are looking for an individual who is comfortable with generative tools and skilled at crafting effective prompts to enhance daily tasks. 

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in a complex sales cycle, strong analytical mindset and ability to uncover new revenue opportunities are mandatory requirements. 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: 

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. 

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). 

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. 

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn ! 

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here. 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub 

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. 

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. 

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

- Du hältst alle relevanten Stakeholder regelmäßig über den aktuellen Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.

- Du identifizierst, konzipierst und implementierst AI-Anwendungen , die unsere Softwarelösungen und internen Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter machen – von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.

Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

0–3 Monate:

- Du lernst die Leadbase (Matching, Dialer, Partner-Portal, Versand & Abrechnung sowie APIs) und die wichtigsten Stakeholder aus Vertrieb, Operations und Tech kennen.

- Du übernimmst die Pflege des Backlogs sowie die laufende Priorisierung der Tickets im Tech-Team.

4–6 Monate:

- Du verantwortest eigenständig ein größeres Feature oder eine Produktinitiative der Leadbase – von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout.

- Du stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Fachbereichen und priorisierst Anforderungen nach ihrem Nutzen und ihrer Relevanz.

- Du identifizierst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI und setzt erste Prozessoptimierungen um (z. B. zur Automatisierung von Anforderungsprozessen oder zur Steigerung der internen Produktivität).

7–12 Monate:

- Du gestaltest die Produktstrategie für Lead Matching und angrenzende Module (z. B. Dialer, Multi-Channel und Partner-API) aktiv mit und bringst mindestens ein strategisches Vorhaben erfolgreich in Produktion.

- Du hast mindestens eine KI-Lösung erfolgreich produktiv eingeführt.

- Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Produktfragen rund um die Leadbase und wirst von Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern als verlässliche Schnittstelle wahrgenommen.

Das bringst du mit

- Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem agilen Umfeld mit – idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Tech-Unternehmen.

- Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und hast Freude daran, die Brücke zwischen Business und Entwicklung zu schlagen.

- Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit künstlicher Intelligenz oder ein fundiertes Interesse daran, KI-Lösungen praxisnah im Unternehmenskontext einzusetzen.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert und proaktiv und kannst komplexe Anforderungen in klare Aufgaben und Prioritäten übersetzen.

- Du kommunizierst sicher und verständlich – auch bei technischen Themen und mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.

- Du begeisterst dich für datengetriebene, digitale Produkte und hast den Anspruch, Dinge aktiv voranzubringen und nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Das bieten wir dir

- Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.

- Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.

- Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).

- Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.

- 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.

- Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).

- Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.

- Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.

- Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).

- Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.

- Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.

- Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings , wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.

- Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.

- Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.

- Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.

Das sind unsere Werte

- Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.

- Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.

- Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

Jobbeschreibung

Lovebetter wächst.

Und Wachstum braucht Führung.

Unser bisheriger COO zieht sich bewusst aus dem operativen Tagesgeschäft zurück, um neue Wachstumsprojekte voranzutreiben. Das operative Herz des Unternehmens braucht deshalb eine neue Instanz mit voller Verantwortung, klarem Blick und echter Entscheidungskraft .

Diese Rolle ist kein Verwalterjob. Sie ist die Position, die dafür sorgt, dass das Unternehmen läuft, skaliert – oder stehen bleibt .

Wenn du einen exzellenten Job machst, wächst Lovebetter.

Wenn nicht, tut es niemand.

Wofür Lovebetter steht

Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.

Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung liebt , Wirkung über Resultate erzeugt – und weiß, dass echter Impact aus Exzellenz, Struktur und Umsetzungskraft entsteht.

Deine Mission als COO

- Du bist der operative Geschäftsführer von Lovebetter.

- Der Mensch, der das Gesamtunternehmen steuert, priorisiert, absichert und nach vorne bringt.

- Du führst die Führungskräfte.

- Du hältst die Zahlen.

- Du triffst Entscheidungen – auch die unbequemen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Führung der Führungskräfte Head of Sales, Head of Marketing und Head of Fulfillment sowie Backoffice/Assistenz, Business Development und HR/Recruiting berichten direkt an dich. Du führst, entwickelst, forderst – und triffst Personalentscheidungen, wenn nötig.

- Operative Gesamtsteuerung des Unternehmens Du hältst den Überblick über alle Abteilungen, KPIs, Cashflow, Kostenstrukturen und Engpässe – täglich, nicht nur im Report.

- Zahlen, Finanzen & Entscheidungen Du verstehst komplexe Zusammenhänge – inklusive P&L, Cashflow und Forecasting –, erkennst Risiken früh und triffst unternehmerische Entscheidungen auf Basis von Fakten.

- Strukturen, Prozesse & Skalierung Du erkennst Schwachstellen, baust klare Prozesse, reduzierst Abhängigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass Wachstum nicht chaotisch wird.

- Menschen & Kommunikation Du führst Mitarbeitergespräche und Gehaltsgespräche mit Fingerspitzengefühl, führst finale Hiring-Gespräche bei relevanten Rollen mit und sorgst dafür, dass Events und Webinare organisatorisch sauber laufen.

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer Du bist Sparringspartner, Umsetzer und Realitätscheck – und sorgst dafür, dass Visionen sauber in operative Exzellenz übersetzt werden. Dein Ziel: Du nimmst der Geschäftsführung das operative Tagesgeschäft Schritt für Schritt vollständig ab.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

- Echter Hebel: Deine Entscheidungen beeinflussen Umsatz, Gewinn, Team & Wachstum direkt

- Freiheit & Verantwortung: Kein Mikromanagement – sondern klare Ergebnisverantwortung

- Markt mit massivem Potenzial: Weitgehend unbesetzt, gesellschaftlich relevant

- High-Performance-Kultur: Leistung, Klarheit und Ownership sind Standard

- Gestaltungsraum: Prozesse, Strukturen und Team auf Top-Niveau formen

- Echte Perspektive: Bei passender Entwicklung kann diese Rolle mittelfristig in Richtung CEO wachsen

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

- ein hochprofitables, sauberes Unternehmen

- ein leistungsstarkes, klares Team

- nachhaltiges Wachstum ohne Chaos

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung .

Erzähl uns lieber:

- wo du bereits skaliert hast

- wofür du Verantwortung getragen hast

- und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetter operations-seitig auf das nächste Level bringst.

Stellenanforderungen

Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

du mindestens 3 Jahre als COO oder Geschäftsführer gearbeitet hast

- du bereits 20+ Mitarbeitende geführt hast – idealerweise in einem etablierten, profitablen Unternehmen (40–50+ Mitarbeitende), nicht ausschließlich im frühen Startup

- du nachweislich Unternehmen skaliert oder stark mitentwickelt hast

- du exzellent mit Zahlen bist und komplexe Zusammenhänge wirklich verstehst

- du strukturiert, analytisch und entscheidungsstark arbeitest

- du kommunikativ sattelfest bist – auch in sensiblen Mitarbeiter- und Gehaltsgesprächen

- du persönlich einen echten Bezug zu Wachstum und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung hast – als Haltung, nicht als Buzzword

- du unter Druck ruhig bleibst und Verantwortung nicht abgibst

- du egoarm bist, Feedback annimmst und Klarheit über Harmonie stellst

- du belastbar bist und auch Phasen mit hohem Workload souverän managst

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

- du Zahlen „gefühlt“ statt analytisch bewertest

- du extrem beziehungsgetrieben oder konfliktscheu bist

- du deine eigenen Ideen ungefiltert durchdrücken willst

- du wenig strukturiert und organisiert bist

- du Verantwortung lieber teilst als trägst

title: Senior Sales Director
description:
Life at Plume 

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

Role Description: 
Plume works with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to run the connected experience inside their
subscribers' homes and small businesses. Our platform sits between their network and the people using
it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We
are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East.
The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they
are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home.
Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think
about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale.
We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather
than in a broad prospecting territory.
It is a role with real ownership. You will be the face of Plume in the region, working directly with our
executive team and with senior leaders at some of the best-known ISPs in the market.

Responsibilities: 
• A named list of UK and Ireland ISPs, covering both new logos and the growth of existing
deployments into new services, subscriber tiers and lines of business.
• A multi-million-dollar annual quota carried across new business and installed base expansion.
• The full cycle: executive access, discovery, business case, technical validation and POC,
commercial modelling, procurement, contract, and a clean handover into delivery. You stay
accountable through launch.
• The relationship map inside each account. Not a single champion, but the CTO, the Chief Product
or Consumer officer, the owner of customer care and operations, and whoever holds the broadband
P&L.
• A virtual team pulled from solutions engineering, product, delivery, finance, legal and executive
sponsorship. You direct it. You do not wait for it.
• Accurate forecasting. Deals of this size move, and we would rather know early than late.
• A clear read on the market: how ISPs in the region are approaching the connected home, where
their priorities are shifting, and what that means for our roadmap. You are our eyes in the territory.

Qualifications: 
This role calls for someone who already understands how ISPs buy. Their decision cycles, stakeholder
structures and commercial models are specific to the industry, and the experience we are looking for
reflects that.
• A track record selling hardware, software, cloud or platform solutions directly to ISPs, with evidence
of recurring or subscription-based commercial models. Your experience should be with ISPs as the
buyer, rather than with a telco's enterprise IT function as one account among many.
• Ownership of deals in the multi-million-dollar ACV range, with 9 to 24 month cycles, formal
procurement, and an established solution already in place.
• Fluency in ISP economics. ARPU and attach rates, churn and retention drivers, cost to serve,
contact volumes and handling time, truck roll avoidance, CPE fleet lifecycle and ODM relationships,
NPS. You should be able to build a credible business case yourself before a solutions engineer is in
the room.
• Experience winning business where the customer already had a solution in place, whether bought
or built in-house. That is a different commercial conversation, and we place real weight on it.

• Existing senior relationships across UK and Ireland ISPs, or a specific and realistic plan for building
them inside two quarters.
• MEDDPICC applied in practice rather than in theory. Expect to walk us through a live deal from your
current role against it.
• Comfort operating without a finished playbook. Our product moves, our commercial models evolve,
and parts of this territory are still being defined. You will be building as you sell.
• Consistent quota attainment, and the ability to explain honestly where you missed and why.
• Willingness to travel regularly across UK and Ireland, and occasionally across EMEA.

About Plume 

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

title: Supplier Co-Ordinator Analyst
description:
About Allica Bank 

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description 

Allica's Product teams own the end-to-end product experience across Payments, Financial Crime, Lending, Deposits, Digital Tools and much more - working daily with a wide range of third-party suppliers whose services are woven into the heart of what we build. Managing those relationships well is a competitive advantage, and it's governed by Allica's Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, with active review cycles running quarterly to annually.

You'll be the person who keeps Product's supplier relationships running like clockwork - spotting what needs attention before it becomes a problem and giving the team the confidence that nothing's falling through the cracks. Working closely with TPRM, Compliance, Legal and Procurement teams, you'll build a reputation as the go-to person who makes things happen across the business.

Role Description 

As Supplier Coordinator/Analyst, you'll be at the centre of how Product manages its suppliers - making sure Allica stays on top of every review, renewal and requirement across a fast-growing supplier estate, in line with our TPRM framework.

This is an individual contributor role built for someone who thrives on staying ahead of things: you're the person Product comes to for a clear answer on what's due and what's outstanding, and the one who catches a licence, renewal or review before it becomes due.

Principal Accountabilities 

- Own the administrative lifecycle of periodic supplier reviews (quarterly, bi-annual, annual depending upon tier) - chasing and collating required inputs from suppliers and internal stakeholders

- Draft review paperwork and flag obvious risks or gaps for the Product Owner to assess and sign off

- Track outstanding actions arising from reviews through to closure, so nothing falls through the cracks between cycles

- Track licence and contract renewal dates across the Product supplier estate and raise renewals in good time

- Complete renewal paperwork and liaise with Legal and Procurement teams

- Raise ad hoc requests such as additional licences or user seats for platforms as needed by the team

- Keep supplier records accurate and up to date in internal systems, acting as the source-of-truth checkpoint for audit and review purposes

- Identify repetitive data-collection tasks across the review cycle and build automation or templates to reduce manual effort

- Act as the go-to point of contact for Product individuals on all things supplier management, coordinating directly with internal teams 

- Support new vendor onboarding administration - coordinating legal and compliance approvals and owning the onboarding process end to end, while the Product Owner/tribe lead retains ownership of budget and contract terms

- Document and monitor the data sources shared with vendors, maintaining an accurate, easily queryable record (e.g. via Gatekeeper) in place of ad hoc spreadsheet exercises, working closely with Product Owners who hold the detailed knowledge of what is shared

- Support the tracking and management of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) linked to supplier data sharing, ensuring assessments are current and reviewed on schedule

- Apply controls around requests to extend or add new data sources shared with suppliers, ensuring appropriate sign-off is obtained before any extension

Personal Attributes & Experience 

- Some exposure to supplier, vendor or contract administration, ideally within a regulated or financial services environment 

- Highly organised with strong attention to detail; comfortable chasing multiple stakeholders and suppliers without letting things slip

- Confident with Excel and internal systems (e.g. Confluence, JIRA); quick to pick up new tools

- Clear, professional written and spoken communication 

- A proactive, practical problem-solver who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked

- Comfortable working to a framework and escalating and resolving ambiguous or edge cases 

Working at Allica Bank 

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

- Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

- Options for flexible working

- Regular social activities

- Pension contributions

- Discretionary bonus scheme

- Private health cover

- Life assurance

title: Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer
description:
About Allica Bank 

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description 

This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.

Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

Principal Accountabilities 

- Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations.  

- Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers.  

- Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays.  

- Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned.  

- Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure.  

- Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards.  

- Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified.  

- Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans.  

- Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 

- Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner.  

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting.  

- Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules.  

- Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience 

- Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery.  

- Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms.  

- A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.  

- Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses.  

- Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience.  

- Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team.  

- Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services.  

- Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 

title: Customer Operations Associate, Transfers
description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the Role 

As a Customer Operations Associate, you’ll join our Transfers team within Operations, where your initial focus will be on building deep expertise in transfers and delivering great outcomes for our customers.

You’ll help customers move their investment accounts and assets into and out of Freetrade, owning cases from start to finish and working with customers, external counterparties and teams across the business to make sure transfers are completed accurately, efficiently and within the required timelines.

This is detailed, deadline-driven work where accuracy, ownership and follow-through really matter. You’ll develop a strong understanding of the rules and regulations governing ISA transfers, alongside the operational processes involved in cash and stock transfers, valuations, asset acceptance and CREST. You will also build experience across areas such as JISAs, fund transfers and European stock transfers.

At the centre of the role is genuine care about getting the customer the right outcome. We’re looking for people who take ownership, care deeply about the experience customers have and are willing to follow a problem through until it’s resolved.

Your initial focus will be Transfers, but our longer-term ambition is to build a more cross-trained and flexible Operations team. As you develop, there may be opportunities to gain exposure to other areas such as Payments, Corporate Actions, Trading & Settlements, Customer Service and Complaints, helping you build a broader understanding of how Operations works and how different workflows connect.

This isn’t a rotation programme, and there’s no set timeline or expectation that you’ll move between teams. Opportunities to broaden your knowledge will depend on your development, team priorities and the needs of the business.

Our aim is to develop operators with both depth and breadth across Operations - people who understand their own area deeply, can connect the dots across different workflows and use that knowledge to get better outcomes for customers.

AI and automation are a real part of how Operations is evolving at Freetrade. We’re looking for people who are genuinely enthusiastic about using technology to continuously improve their work - actively finding ways to work faster and smarter and contributing to automation and efficiency improvements as they go.

What You'll Do 

- Own transfer cases from start to finish, helping customers move ISA, JISA, GIA and SIPP accounts and assets into and out of Freetrade, with a focus on accuracy and a smooth customer outcome

- Process transfer applications accurately and within agreed SLAs.

- Process valuations and provide acceptance of assets within agreed SLAs.

- Chase and monitor transfer progress with external counterparties and customers, taking ownership of cases through to completion.

- Build a strong working knowledge of ISA and SIPP transfer rules, regulations and operational requirements.

- Work with CREST processes and develop your understanding of stock and asset transfers.

- Provide technical support to our Customer Service team, helping them answer customer queries accurately and efficiently.

- Communicate clearly with customers through email and in-app chat and, as our support channels evolve, potentially phone.

- Keep clear, accurate records of the cases you handle to support quality, compliance and audit standards.

- Spot patterns in the cases and queries you handle, identifying process gaps and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

- Review procedures and contribute to process enhancements, challenging inefficient ways of working and helping make things better.

- Use AI tools as a core part of your day-to-day workflow, actively looking for practical ways to improve your productivity, quality and the efficiency of the wider team.

- Support the wider Transfers team with ad-hoc tasks and changing priorities when needed.

- Work closely with your workflow lead to align on priorities and flag anything getting in the way of good customer outcomes.

- Support newer joiners as your own knowledge and experience grow.

- Champion a customer-first mindset in everything you do, treating every case with the same level of care you would expect if it were your own account.

About you 

- A genuinely customer-obsessed mindset, with a strong desire to deliver the right outcome and a great experience for every customer

- Exceptional attention to detail, recognising that the processes you’ll work on are critical to the business and can have regulatory and customer implications if not completed accurately

- The ability to work independently and proactively, taking ownership of your workload and following cases through to completion

- A self-starter mindset, with the confidence to identify problems, take initiative and drive changes or improvements without needing significant direction or support

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, colleagues and external counterparties

- A continuous improvement mindset, with experience or an interest in reviewing procedures, identifying gaps and making practical process enhancements

- Strong judgement and ownership, with the confidence to make good decisions while knowing when something needs to be escalated

- Experience with, or knowledge of, CREST transfers would be beneficial, alongside knowledge of ISA transfers, JISAs, fund transfers or European stock transfers

- Genuine enthusiasm for using AI as part of your day-to-day work, with curiosity about how it can improve processes, quality and operational efficiency

- Curiosity and learning agility, with an appetite to build deep expertise in Transfers while developing a broader understanding of Operations over time

Our hybrid model 

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday , Tuesday , and Thursday , leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration to build a strong culture, but we know "life happens." If you have caregiving or personal responsibilities that require extra flexibility, let’s talk about it.

Interview Process

- Initial interview – A chat with our Talent Partner
