title: Global PRP Program Manager (Remote - USA)
description:
Role Overview

PIC, a Genus PLC company, has an exciting opportunity. We are looking for a Global Pig Resistant Product (PRP) Program Manager (remote). 

This role leads the integration, coordination, and governance efforts of PIC's global PRP program. As PRP expands across multiple markets with unique regulatory, commercial, stewardship, and stakeholder requirements, this role ensures the program operates as one coordinated system rather than a collection of independent workstreams.

The Global PRP Program Manager maintains a holistic view of the PRP program, continuously connecting people, priorities, decisions, and workstreams to ensure the program remains aligned, adaptable, and positioned for successful commercialization. The role enables department and workstream leads to focus on their core responsibilities by removing barriers, simplifying cross-functional coordination, and creating the operational discipline needed to successfully scale PRP globally.

The successful candidate can work in a culturally diverse, fast-paced environment and establish priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy. The candidate can work autonomously as well as collaboratively across functional teams, demonstrating strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Success is measured through cross-functional alignment, effective governance, timely execution, proactive risk management, commercialization readiness, organizational accountability, and the successful expansion of PRP across global markets.

This position is based remotely in the United States, with travel approximately of 10% domestically.

The salary range for this position is $126,500 - $153,000 USD annually. The salary provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Genus considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate's work experience, location, education/training, and key skills. 

You Will

- Serve as the primary coordinator and integrator across all PRP workstreams, ensuring alignment and execution as a unified global program.

- Build and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships & relationships across commercialization, regulatory, legal, stewardship, supply chain, product development, quality, marketing, franchise, and leadership teams.

- Lead the governance framework and operating rhythm for the PRP program, including meetings, reviews, decision-making processes, and reporting structures.

- Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, dependencies, resource needs, opportunities, and organizational barriers to execution.

- Drive organizational accountability by tracking decisions, commitments, action items, approvals, and contractual obligations through completion.

- Develop and maintain standardized governance tools, dashboards, templates, reporting, and operational processes to improve visibility and consistency across the program.

- Own and continuously improve the cross-functional PRP Market Readiness Framework, ensuring commercialization readiness across global markets.

- Coordinate commercialization planning activities, scenario evaluations, and cross-functional readiness efforts to support strategic decision-making and market expansion.

- Monitor evolving regulatory, commercial, operational, and market conditions and ensure program plans adapt while maintaining organizational alignment.

- Maintain a comprehensive view of program progress, strategic decisions, lessons learned, and key documentation, enabling effective communication and organizational learning.

- Facilitate communication and coordination among global markets, franchises, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure insights are incorporated into program strategies and priorities.

- Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance governance, commercialization effectiveness, scalability, cross-functional collaboration, and overall program performance.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications (required):

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Project Management, Supply Chain or a related field.

- Progressive years of experience in program management, commercialization, product development, operations, strategic planning, or related business functions.

- Demonstrated success leading large, complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple functions, stakeholders, and business priorities.

- Experience managing strategic business initiatives from planning through execution.

- Proven ability to influence, align, and build effective working relationships across diverse teams without direct reporting authority.

- Experience developing and managing governance frameworks, executive reporting, operating cadences, and decision-making processes.

- Strong organizational, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complexity into actionable plans.

- Demonstrated ability to identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and business impacts while proactively driving solutions.

- Experience working within global organizations and coordinating activities across multiple regions, cultures, and functional teams.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Master's degree (MBA, MSc, or related advanced degree).

- PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project/program management certification.

- Experience within animal health, agriculture, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, healthcare, or other regulated industries.

- Experience supporting global product launches, commercialization programs, or market expansion initiatives.

title: Strategic Implementation Consultant
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara ’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara ’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal. 

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara 's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within. 

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara ’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. 

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays. 

You should apply if:

- 
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

- 
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

- 
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara , you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

- 
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara . This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

- 
You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

- Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.

- Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.

- Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.

- Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.

- Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara ’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.

- Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.

- Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.

- Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara ’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

- 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.

- This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.

- Experience supporting or working with technical products.

- Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.

- Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.

- Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.

- Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.

- Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

- Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

- Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.

- Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$100,406—$153,409 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara , we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara , we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara , we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara ’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience. Learn more about how we deliver excellence for our customers and colleagues at DXC.com.

At DXC we use the power of technology to deliver mission critical IT Services that our customers need to modernize operations and drive innovation across their entire IT estate. We provide services across the Enterprise Technology Stack for business process outsourcing, insurance, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing, and modern workplace.

Our DXC Insurance Services help our customers optimize and transform operations, lower costs, increase agile new channels to growth. Our people, technology and best practices improve and automate highly complex business processes middle and back offices- while facilitating customer experience transformation.

Essential Job Functions

The Project Manager plans, coordinates, and oversees customer-facing software implementation, migration, and custom projects. This includes preparing customer kickoff materials, developing and maintaining milestone plans, coordinating resource requests, tracking project financials, managing invoices, facilitating regular project meetings, documenting meeting minutes, monitoring risks and issues, and ensuring clear communication across all stakeholders.

- Manage multiple customer projects concurrently, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer expectations are effectively controlled.

- Develop, maintain, and communicate project milestone plans, schedules, status updates, meeting minutes, action items, and project documentation.

- Own and track forecasts, actuals, revenue, billing, project hours, invoices, and other financial measures to support accurate project reporting and contract compliance.

- Identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints; recommend and implement mitigation plans as appropriate.

- Monitor and identify potential scope changes or scope creep; coordinate change control activities when additional work or revised requirements are identified.

- Coordinate with internal teams, technical resources, customers, and stakeholders to manage business requirements, technical requirements, schedules, and deliverables.

- Facilitate customer and internal project meetings, ensuring decisions, action items, risks, and follow-ups are clearly documented and communicated.

- Oversee assigned project team activities by providing direction, clarifying priorities, tracking progress, and ensuring deadlines and objectives are understood.

- Support continuous improvement by contributing to new procedures, templates, and process enhancements that improve delivery consistency and customer outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

- Five or more years of project management experience, preferably managing multiple small to mid-sized customer software projects concurrently without dedicated project teams.

- Experience executing projects in MS Project and MS Excel.

- Experience managing software implementation, upgrade, migration, or IT delivery projects through the full project lifecycle.

- Strong knowledge of project management practices, including project planning, budget tracking, forecasting, risk management, issue management, change control, quality assurance, and delivery governance.

- Experience working with customer business objectives, critical success factors, contractual requirements, and project performance measures.

- Experience working within a software development or implementation lifecycle, including requirements, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and transition to support.

Other Qualifications

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, project teams, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage many active projects, competing priorities, and frequent context switching.

- High attention to detail, particularly in meeting minutes, project tracking, financial reporting, invoice approvals, issue follow-up, and risk documentation.

- Ability to anticipate issues, recommend practical solutions, and drive follow-through to resolution.

- Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build trust, manage expectations, and support successful project outcomes.

- Experience with insurance, claims software, or claims administration is preferred.

- Ability to work effectively in a team environment and contribute to process, template, and procedural improvements.

- Willingness to work outside standard business hours when required to support project needs or customer commitments.

- May require occasional travel.

title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. 

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. 

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. 

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

- Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles

- Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering

- Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management

- Job and project tracking

- Client and vendor dashboards

- Online payments and transaction tracking

- Reviews and ratings

- Notifications and communications

- Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities

- Admin tools for managing the platform

- Reporting and analytics

- Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. 

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

- Full-stack web development

- Mobile or cross-platform app development

- Strong front-end and back-end development

- Multi-user marketplace platforms

- User authentication and account management

- Payment gateway integrations

- Databases and APIs

- Third-party integrations

- Dashboards and reporting

- Secure, scalable application architecture

- Cloud hosting and deployment

- Testing, maintenance, and optimization

- Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

- Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs 

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. 

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

- You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.

- With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.

- You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

- You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.

- Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.

- You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.

- You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.

- You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.

- You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

- You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.

- You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.

- You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.

- You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

- An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.

- The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.

- An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!

- A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.

- A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

- Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!

- A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.

- A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.

- The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

- Masters degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience.

title: Software Engineer - Query Execution
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future 

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com. 

About the role 
Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine. You’ll learn how Dremio’s query runtime works while contributing to areas such as query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, scheduling, and performance.

What you’ll be doing 

- Build and support execution-engine components: Implement, test, debug, and maintain well-defined changes to query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, and resource management.

- Develop reliable software: Write clear, maintainable Java code; add unit and integration tests; and follow established engineering practices for code review, testing, and documentation.

- Investigate issues: Help diagnose query correctness, reliability, and performance issues using query profiles, logs, telemetry, benchmarks, and production data.

- Learn runtime and performance fundamentals: Build familiarity with vectorized processing, concurrency, memory usage, parallelism, data exchange, and disk spilling.

- Collaborate with the team: Work closely with senior engineers and partner teams to understand requirements, break work into manageable tasks, and deliver incremental improvements.

- Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation, while validating results through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.

- Grow your engineering skills: Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, seek feedback, and steadily take on broader technical responsibility.

What we’re looking for 

- Software engineering foundation: Up to two years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects.

- Programming skills: Proficiency in Java or another object-oriented programming language; willingness to learn and work in a large Java codebase.

- Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic concurrency concepts.

- Problem-solving ability: Able to work through well-defined technical problems, ask good questions, and apply feedback to reach a solution.

- Quality mindset: Commitment to writing tested, maintainable code and learning established development, testing, and review practices.

- Communication and collaboration: Able to communicate progress, surface blockers early, and work effectively with teammates.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus points if you have 

- 

- Exposure to database internals, query processing, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing.

- Familiarity with performance-oriented software concepts such as profiling, memory management, concurrency, or vectorized processing.

- Experience with C++, Apache Arrow, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.

- Contributions to open-source projects.

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife. 

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor. 

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates 

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here .

title: Director of Media Strategy & Activation (Paid Media)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description 

Dropbox is looking for a Director of Media to own our total media investment—performance and brand—under a single leader. 

This leader will build a unified media strategy that brings performance marketing and brand investments together into one investment thesis and one operating model. They will own the media portfolio end-to-end, from upper-funnel brand campaigns through paid search, paid social, programmatic, mobile, and emerging channels, making investment tradeoffs as business priorities evolve. 

The role also owns how the media organization operates, balancing in-house expertise, agency partnerships, and specialist support to maximize speed, quality, and impact. 

The ideal candidate has worked on both sides of the industry—building media expertise at an agency before leading media inside a technology or high-growth company. They understand what great agency partnerships look like while also knowing how to build world-class internal capabilities. 

This role sits at the center of Dropbox's growth strategy, connecting brand, performance marketing, Product Growth, Sales, and Marketing Data Science to drive measurable business outcomes. 

Responsibilities 

- 
Unified Media Strategy. Build and own Dropbox's media strategy across brand and performance. Set the annual and quarterly investment thesis, define the channel portfolio, and make the tradeoff decisions on where spend moves and why.

- 
Total Budget Ownership. Manage Dropbox's full media investment across paid search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, mobile, affiliate, and brand channels. Own planning, forecasting, pacing, and in-quarter reallocation against efficiency and growth targets.

- 
Brand and Performance Integration. Align reach, frequency, creative strategy, and channel mix so brand and performance investment reinforce each other rather than compete. Partner closely with the Brand organization, which owns brand positioning and creative direction, to translate brand strategy into media execution. 

- 
Operating Model and Partnerships. Design and run the right mix of in-house capability and agency partnership. Own agency relationships, and build the internal muscle where needed. 

- 
AI-Enabled Media Operations. Develop and execute a point of view on where agentic and AI-enabled workflows belong in the media stack — creative production and testing velocity, audience modeling, budget allocation, bid strategy, reporting, and quality control. Make deliberate decisions about where machine judgment outperforms human judgment, and where it does not. 

- 
Connect Media to Revenue. Partner with Product Growth, Sales, and Marketing Data Science to connect media signals to downstream outcomes — activation, conversion, product-qualified leads, expansion, and retention. Build the acquisition layer of a unified self-serve and sales-assisted revenue system. 

- 
Measurement Rigor. Partner with Marketing Data Science on attribution, incrementality testing, and media mix modeling. Be a sophisticated consumer and challenger of measurement methodology, and translate complex performance tradeoffs into crisp, executive-ready recommendations. 

- 
Team Leadership. Lead and grow a team of channel and brand media leaders. Build clarity on what each person owns, how they are measured, and how their work ladders to revenue. 

Requirements 

- 10+ years in media, performance marketing, or digital marketing with increasing scope and leadership responsibility, at a high-growth B2B and/or B2C company 

- 4+ years leading teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and org design 

- Deep, hands-on expertise across paid channels — search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, mobile — including planning, forecasting, budget pacing, audience design, and performance management 

- Experience owning brand media alongside performance media, with working knowledge of brand lift measurement, reach and frequency planning, and creative performance optimization 

- Track record managing significant media budgets with clear, demonstrated impact on acquisition efficiency, pipeline, or revenue 

- Experience managing agency and vendor ecosystems — scoping, selecting, and holding partners accountable — and building in-house capability where it creates advantage 

- Strong analytical fluency: attribution approaches, incrementality testing, MMM/MTA concepts, and unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback) 

- Experience marketing across self-serve, product-led, and sales-assisted motions, and adapting programs across consumer, SMB, and mid-market segments 

- Excellent executive communication: you can turn a complicated performance picture into a clear recommendation and defend it 

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Agency and in-house background. You built your craft agency-side and then brought that capability in-house at a technology or high-growth company. You have operated on both sides of the partnership. 

- 
AI and agentic media workflows. Demonstrated use of AI-enabled workflows in a media context — creative generation and testing, audience modeling, automated reporting, budget or bid optimization — with a clear view of where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk. Candidates with less conventional experience will be strongly considered if they spike here. 

- 
Experience building a media strategy or media planning function 

- 
Familiarity with modern martech and adtech stacks: CDPs, marketing automation, attribution platforms, tagging and data governance 

- 
Experience navigating measurement disruption — privacy changes, cookie deprecation, first-party data strategy 

- 
Multi-product portfolio experience, including cross-sell and attach motions 

- 
International or EMEA media experience

title: Senior Director, Field Enablement
description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - San Francisco, CA)

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

PagerDuty is seeking a Sr. Director, Field Enablement to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Sr. Director of Field Enablement, you will lead a team of enablement professionals supporting our sales, customer success, and partnership organizations. 

You will build and scale our global enablement function to ensure our customer-facing teams are equipped to sell and support our diversifying product portfolio as we enter our next phase of growth. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the enablement strategy for a high-growth SaaS company and directly improve teams' capabilities and productivity worldwide. The ideal candidate is a strategic, seasoned enablement leader passionate about gathering customer feedback and competitive intelligence to develop programs that drive sales excellence and business results.

ABOUT PAGERDUTY 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Develop, execute, optimize, and assess enablement programs in partnership with sales and customer success leadership, determining priorities and success metrics with key stakeholders

- Gather and share insights from customers, competitors, and the market to enable the positioning of PagerDuty’s value proposition to the market

- Drive the creation of learning programs and events that align with overall sales and company strategy, enhancing team capabilities, productivity, and high-level selling skills

- Build and maintain an enablement delivery platform that provides scalable, measurable content and learning resources to sales, customer success, and partnership teams

- Collaborate with marketing and product marketing to develop highly effective and repeatable sales messaging, selling tools, and collateral that enable consistent execution

- Design and maintain an end-to-end sales onboarding program in collaboration with HR that certifies new hires on company strategy, product messaging, and sales processes

- Develop and lead the everboarding process for the sales team to ensure the continued development of required behaviors and skills to successfully operate a consumption driven business

- Build out and scale enablement support functions for Customer Success and Partnerships organizations

- Communicate the enablement strategy, roadmap, and KPIs to stakeholders across all global organizations

- Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement resources, including sales playbooks, battle cards, product collateral, content library, and competitive intelligence

- Drive adoption and utilization of sales enablement tools such as MindTickle and Highspot

- Partner with the sales systems team to drive adoption and utilization of sales tools such as Clari, Salesloft, Salesforce, and others

- Conduct regular assessments and audits of sales processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization. 

- Set key metrics to assess the impact of sales enablement efforts on sales performance

- Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in sales enablement

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus

- 10+ years of sales enablement experience or a combination of sales / post sales, sales training, and enablement roles

- 5+ years of management experience leading and developing enablement teams

- Proven track record of building and delivering innovative, strategic sales enablement programs, including training, onboarding, certifications, and sales events

- Experience implementing and maintaining content management platforms such as Highspot or Seismic

- 3+ years of experience in high-velocity, high-growth startup environments, preferably in the SaaS space, or equivalent degree or experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

- Strong understanding of sales methodologies such as Force Management, MEDDIC and forecasting best practices

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively train and influence sales professionals at all levels

- Experience with Sales Operations and Salesforce.com 

- Proficiency in using sales enablement tools, CRM systems, and content management platforms. Preferred platforms include Salesforce, Seismic, CRM Analytics, and more

- Analytical mindset with the ability to provide actionable insights

- Knowledge of Sales Manager training and sales coaching, particularly for Enterprise sales

- Strong program and project management skills with the ability to maintain calendars of ongoing training, business reviews, and field communications

- Detail and results-oriented with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution

- Collaborative and team-oriented approach with the ability to work cross-functionally

- Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for driving sales excellence

- Excel in creating and curating sales collateral, playbooks, training modules, and other resources to support the sales team

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Argentina Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

- Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

- Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

- Application Information:

- Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

- This posting is for a new position.

As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

- Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

- Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

- Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

- Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

- Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

- Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About you 

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

- Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. 

- Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

- Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

- Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

- Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

- Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

- Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

- Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

- Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

- Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

- Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are:

- Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

- Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

- Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors: 

- Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

- Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

- Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

- Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits 

- Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

- Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

- Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

- Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

- Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

- Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 

- Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

- Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. 

Remote, together 

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected 

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog , LinkedIn , X (Twitter) , and/or Glassdoor . 

Please note: 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered. 

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment. 

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes. 

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .
